content.text: In Kenya, digital creators face significant barriers when trying to sell their products internationally due to restrictions on platforms like Stripe and PayPal, limiting their ability to receive payments from global buyers. What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

The COREMERCH solution is built on the principle of infrastructure sovereignty, allowing creators to own and control their digital commerce stacks without relying on third-party platforms. This approach matters because it gives creators the freedom to operate independently, without the risk of account suspensions or payment restrictions. By deploying their own infrastructure, creators can ensure that their businesses are resilient and adaptable to changing market conditions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is based on a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. This stack is integrated with NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, enabling creators to receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies. The result is a seamless and efficient payment processing system that eliminates the need for traditional payment gateways.

How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer. The delivery email arrives in the buyer's inbox within 30 seconds. Nothing in this sequence requires the buyer to have a bank account, a credit card, or a PayPal account. Nothing requires you to be in a supported country.
Sovereign infrastructure gives creators full control.
